reason: The patch itself is in scope and factually sound: it applies cleanly via `git am` on a fresh clone of main @ 9de9551, touches only the top-of-file JSDoc of packages/prx/src/intake/intake-source.ts (+16 comment lines, nothing else), every claim in the new comment checks out against the code (CLI wiring in pr-state/cli.ts, requireSigner('intake') hard refusal, ScoutSourceError-only rewrap, `pinned <ref>` output, return 0), the git-history facts in REPORT.md (ef696de/#241, 395b45f/#283, 92bfe92/#297, stale origin/GH-270 @ 7800b8e) are all real, the commit message is Conventional-Commits `docs(prx): ... (GH-270)` with `Refs #270`, and the longest header line is 83 cols under biome's 100. However it is NOT mergeable as-is: the repo's `.github/workflows/changeset-check.yml` fails any PR whose diff touches `packages/` without adding a `.changeset/*.md` (docs-only changes are explicitly told to add an EMPTY changeset via `bunx @changesets/cli@^2.27 add --empty`), and recent history shows every PR touching packages/prx/src does add one. The patch adds no changeset, REPORT.md never mentions the gate, and the proposed GitHub comment tells the applier to run only typecheck/check/test, so following it as written yields a red check that CONTRIBUTING says must be green before marking ready. Secondary: the issue asked for a 'one-paragraph' summary and no sibling intake-*.ts header carries a per-export list, so the 32-line header with an 'Exports (GH-270)' block is a mild style deviation a maintainer may push back on. No fabricated facts found in the proposed comment; it is accurate but incomplete.
